verdict.rationale: Fellow automatically produces meeting summaries, action items and decisions, which are the raw material for a follow-up. Nothing shows it natively drafts a follow-up email that can be reviewed and sent. The closest paths are workarounds: an external chatbot (Claude, ChatGPT) reading recaps through the MCP connector, or passing transcripts to an LLM via the API for tailored recaps. Missing for 10: a native follow-up email draft feature, a review-and-send flow in a couple of clicks, email/CRM sending integration, and hands-on corroboration.
